{"model": "claude-agentsight-mock", "max_tokens": 64, "messages": [{"role": "assistant", "content": "Two companies share public IP 203.0.113.9. Give each its own SSL VPN virtual gateway (ports 4433 and 4434) under separate virtual systems; each user may reach only their own company's resources.

Shared public IP 203.0.113.9; tenant A on :4433, tenant B on :4434; isolate with a netns per tenant.
PLAN:
ip netns add tenantA; ip netns add tenantB
ip netns exec tenantA ocserv -c /etc/ocserv/a.conf   # 203.0.113.9:4433
ip netns exec tenantB ocserv -c /etc/ocserv/b.conf   # 203.0.113.9:4434"}]}
